title: Audit the smaller epithelial atlas object for a donor-level independent comparison
question: Does the public epithelial trajectory object preserve a documented count layer and clinical and technical links needed for a donor-level comparison?
scope: Schema, provenance and aggregate clinical support in the smaller GSE266265 epithelial RDS. No gene- or pathway-outcome analysis.
steps: Check the author's source, file identity and access.
Inspect the smaller object in a bounded local process without emitting individual identifiers or signal values.
Document available assays, clinical and technical links, cell-type and donor-level feasibility or the specific missing fields.
deliverables: Source-linked aggregate feasibility note and a reproducible bounded inspection.
acceptance: Document object identity, available physical matrix and units or unresolved values.
Establish whether inferential units and eligibility can be verified without matching on personal attributes.
Publish no participant-level records or biological outcome estimates.
